correct.evidence: Points 6, 7 and 8 are met, and point 5 for fields, lists and typed dates. A reversed trip or CPT date makes the engine ask <stage>.<record>.ends_before_starts, and Home shows 'Duly has a question about what you entered.' with 'Asked because of: Conflict trip t1 ends before starts.'. Three checks on a2 show three identical rows and one Why line.

sourced.evidence: No rule, number or quote added; FIELD_WORDS and RECORD_KINDS follow the pack's label and complete_label.

never_assumes.evidence: Every gap stays a question and the verdict stays cannot_tell. Different conflicts on one record share one title and cannot be told apart.

inside_the_boundary.evidence: questionTitle and becauseLine read for 42 engine question ids plus 8 more forms; none is advice or a conclusion about the person.

secure.evidence: No new input path. measuredWidths races a timeout, and fitsWindows fails closed on a window not measured or not at its width.

tested.evidence: The ends_before_starts id leak passes all 591 web tests. labels.test reads the pack's records but not path.stages or path.checks, and the Home id test runs on path-stem-next only.

findings.title: span conflict question shows its id on Home
findings.input: web/samples/path-stem-next.case.json with t1 returned_on 2026-04-20, or a1 card_end 2024-05-01; engine.path.compute at 2026-09-30
findings.what_happens: The engine asks trip.t1.ends_before_starts (engine/path.py:763). pathTitle (labels.ts:700) returns null for <stage>.<record>.ends_before_starts, so Home shows 'Duly has a question about what you entered.' and 'Asked because of: Conflict trip t1 ends before starts.' (labels.ts:788). This applies to all ten stages with a span.

findings.title: different checks on one record share one title; Why folds them
findings.input: path-stem-next.case.json with a2 filed_on 2025-01-02, card_start 2025-11-01, card_end 2028-02-09
findings.what_happens: opt_post.filed_in_window.a2, opt_post.card_fits_max_months.a2 and opt_post.starts_after_program_end.a2 show as three rows 'Permission to work 2: Some facts entered do not fit together.' (labels.ts:721). Why shows one line for all three while the count says 20.

findings.title: pack test does not read stages or checks
findings.what_happens: Gives the generic title and a because with the id in spaces, and every test passes. Reading path.stages and path.checks from parameters.yaml as packRecords does would catch it. The Home id test runs on one sample.

findings.title: field words copied by hand from the pack's labels
findings.input: FIELD_WORDS and RECORD_KINDS against parameters.yaml label and complete_label
findings.what_happens: The SPEC asks for the copy in labels.ts and the test catches a missing kind, field or prefix. A pack label changed later will not follow.

findings.title: after_today because line
findings.what_happens: Title says the date is after today; the because says 'the dates entered do not fit together.'
